# Failure conditions

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-errors-doc.mjs from ERROR_CODE_REGISTRY. Do not edit. -->

Every failure a dispatch or a transport returns is a `BusError` with the code
`owner:condition:subject`. Two come back as themselves: a handler's own throw,
and an `Error` given as the abort reason. On the wire a `BusError` is an RFC
9457 problem whose `type`
is this page plus the condition (`.../errors.md#invalid`); the exact code is
the `code` member. A backend's own `type` is kept. A plugin's throw is
`<its id>:failed:plugin`; codes of your own plugins and of your backend are
yours, and read by their condition below.

<a id="missing"></a>

## missing

The thing is not there (404, 410; a handler not registered).

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: NOT_FOUND (a missing handler: UNIMPLEMENTED).

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core:missing:handler` | error | no | No handler registered for action | Register a handler with bus.register(action, handler) before dispatching. |
| `transport:missing:csrf` | error | no | No CSRF token was found after refreshing it | The csrfCookieUrl endpoint must set the XSRF-TOKEN cookie (Laravel Sanctum: /sanctum/csrf-cookie), or the page must carry the csrf-token meta tag. |
| `schema:missing:adapter` | error | no | synthesize() was called without an adapter | Pass options.adapter, an LlmAdapter function that calls your LLM provider. |
| `store:missing:bus` | error | no | useStore() was called without a bus | Pass the bus: useStore(bus). Stores are keyed per bus and never fall back to the shared one. |
| `store:missing:router` | error | no | A store with url fields was given no router | Pass the router: useStore(bus, router). |
| `router:missing:route` | info | no | The URL matches no route | Expected for a server-side page: the default onError hard-navigates and the server renders it. Add a row if the client should own this URL. |
| `router:missing:routes` | error | no | The route table is not loaded yet | Await router.isReady() before resolving or navigating. |
| `router:missing:record` | error | no | No route record has this name | Check the route name against the table (or the loader-bearing records named to revalidateRoutes). |
| `router:missing:parent` | error | no | A route row names a parent that does not exist (dev only) | Add the parent row or fix the parent name. |
| `router:missing:param` | error | no | A required param was not given to build a route's path | Pass every required param to the link or push() for that route. |
| `router:missing:inline` | error | no | No inline routes element matches the selector (or there is no DOM) | Render the element the selector names, or pass rows or { url } instead. |
| `router:missing:url` | error | no | reload() was called without a { url } routes source | reload() refetches the table, so only a { url } source can reload; use setRoutes() for rows. |
| `router:missing:component` | error | no | No component is registered for a route's component key | Register the key in options.components; the default onError hard-navigates so the server renders the page. |
| `router:missing:loader` | error | no | A route's load has no loader handler | Register a preset that serves the template (vapor-chamber/router-fetch, or loaders: { prefixes, url }). |
| `router:missing:fetchBlade` | error | no | A blade route was hit with no fetchBlade available | Pass fetchBlade (or an http client) to the router. |
| `router:missing:http` | error | no | routes: { url } was given no http client | Pass http: routerHttp() from vapor-chamber/router/remote, or any HttpClient of your own. |
| `router:missing:router` | error | no | A router composable or outlet ran with no router installed | Install the router: app.use(router). |
| `core:missing:key` | warn | no | A command the library cannot trace to its effect has no idempotency key (dev only) | Key it with the idempotent plugin, declare it idempotent (retry: { actionPolicies }), or send an Idempotency-Key header. |
| `mcp:missing:filter` | warn | no | createMcpHandler was given no actionFilter: every schema action is exposed (dev only) | Pass an allowlist actionFilter, or createActionFilter([]) to accept full exposure. |
| `store:missing:locks` | warn | no | A shared store found no Web Locks in this page, so it is not shared across tabs (dev only) | Run it where the page has Web Locks, as every browser since March 2022 does: without them two tabs could end on two states. |
| `transport:missing:client` | warn | no | An answer named cache groups, but nothing on the bus reads them (dev only) | Give the transport the http client the router reads, or install cache() on the bus. |
| `vue:missing:vapor` | warn | no | A Vapor helper returned null: Vue with Vapor mode was not detected (dev only) | Run on Vue 3.6+ with Vapor, import from vapor-chamber/vapor, or use the matching define* helper from vue for VDOM mode. |
| `vue:missing:wiring` | warn | no | Composables run without reactivity, cleanup or KeepAlive guard | Import them from vapor-chamber/vue (or /vapor), or call configureVue(Vue) before the first composable. |
| `vue:missing:scope` | warn | no | A composable ran outside a Vue setup() or effectScope() (dev only) | Call the returned dispose() yourself, or run it inside setup() or effectScope(). Expected in tests and scripts. |
| `directive:missing:action` | warn | no | A command binding has no action (dev only) | Bind an action name: v-vc-command="'cartAdd'" or data-vc-command="cartAdd". |
| `bind:missing:store` | warn | no | A display binding names a store the bus does not have (dev only) | Create the store before bindDisplay runs, and name it as "<id>.<field>". |
| `mount:missing:element` | warn | no | VaporChamber.mount found no element for its selector, so nothing is bound (dev only) | Call mount after the element is on the page, with a selector that matches it. |

<a id="already"></a>

## already

It is there already.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: ALREADY_EXISTS.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema:already:action` | error | no | Two schema keys name one action on the bus | Rename one key: each must give its own camelCase name (cart.add and cart_add are both cartAdd). |
| `store:already:member` | error | no | A store action is named like a store member | Rename the action: $id, state, url, $reset, $dispose, $onField and $ready are the store's own. |
| `router:already:route` | error | no | Two route rows share a name (dev only) | Give every row a unique name; the generator should emit them unique. |
| `core:already:handler` | warn | no | A handler was registered over another for one action (dev only) | Call the function register() returned first, or bus.clear() to reset. |
| `core:already:plugin` | warn | no | Two installed plugins share an id (dev only) | Give each plugin its own id: a failure's owner names one plugin. |

<a id="conflict"></a>

## conflict

The state is not the one the request assumed (409, 412). Re-read, then decide.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: ABORTED / FAILED_PRECONDITION.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `router:conflict:base` | warn | no | A fetched route payload declares a base other than the router's | Pass base to createRouter() explicitly, or deliver the table inline. |
| `core:conflict:bus` | warn | no | setCommandBus() replaced a bus getCommandBus() had handed out (dev only) | Call setCommandBus() before anything calls getCommandBus(). |
| `transport:conflict:client` | warn | no | Two transports of one bus have different http clients (dev only) | Give the bus one client: its groups reach the first client only. |

<a id="invalid"></a>

## invalid

Input broke a rule (any other 4xx).

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: INVALID_ARGUMENT / OUT_OF_RANGE.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core:invalid:option` | error | no | A register() option needs another one: optimistic needs an undo | Give the action an undo that takes its change back, or drop optimistic. |
| `core:invalid:handler` | error | no | A handler that could never run: a transport sends its action, or null where no transport does, or not a function | For a sent action register null to declare its options, add optimistic: true to show the change at once, or declare localFallback on a transport whose send calls local(). Otherwise register a function. |
| `core:invalid:name` | warn | no | Action name does not match the naming pattern, or carries a "$" (the library's names) | Rename the action: match the pattern, or adjust naming config in createCommandBus(); names with $ are the library's. |
| `core:invalid:filter` | error | no | An action filter is not a valid CloudEvents filter expression | Use one dialect per expression (exact, prefix, suffix, all, any, not), the action attribute only, a non-empty string, and at least one expression in all or any. |
| `core:invalid:plugin` | error | no | use() was given something other than an object with a part the bus places (a function, a transport), or a plugin already installed on this bus | Pass an object with a part the bus places: started, settled, authorize, validate, reuse, admit, begin or attach. Install a plugin once, or a new instance. Declare a transport at the bus: createAsyncCommandBus({ transport }). |
| `core:invalid:bus` | error | no | commandState() was given a bus this library did not make | Pass a bus from createCommandBus(), createAsyncCommandBus() or createTestBus(): a bus you build yourself has no internal facts observer. |
| `validator:invalid:payload` | error | no | Schema or per-action validation rejected the dispatch | Fix the target/payload fields listed in the error message to match the declared schema. |
| `validateSchemas:invalid:payload` | error | no | Schema or per-action validation rejected the dispatch | Fix the target/payload fields listed in the error message to match the declared schema. |
| `schemaValidator:invalid:payload` | error | no | The bus schema rejected the dispatch | Fix the target/payload fields listed in the error message to match the schema the bus was created with. |
| `supersede:invalid:bus` | error | no | supersede() was installed on a sync bus, where no command is in flight when the next starts | Install supersede on an async bus: createAsyncCommandBus().use(supersede()). |
| `transport:invalid:json` | error | no | The request holds a value JSON cannot encode: nothing was sent | Send only what JSON holds: a BigInt or a cycle cannot be encoded. context.url names the request; the cause is the platform's TypeError. It is never re-sent. |
| `store:invalid:name` | error | no | A store id or action key carries a "$", which names the library's commands | Rename it: names with $ are the library's ($reset, $undo). |
| `store:invalid:coalesce` | error | no | A store declares both coalesce and undo | Drop one: the undo ring records each write as it lands, and a coalesced write lands a microtask later. |
| `router:invalid:parent` | error | no | A route's parent chain loops back on itself (dev only) | A route cannot be its own ancestor: fix the parent names in the cycle the message lists. |
| `router:invalid:menu` | error | no | A menu row breaks the menu rules | meta.menu must be a number, meta.title an i18n key, and a menu route's path must be static. |
| `router:invalid:path` | error | no | A route path segment starting with ':' is not a valid param (dev only) | Use :name, :name(regex), :name? or a trailing /* splat. |
| `router:invalid:component` | error | no | The Vapor outlet was given a non-Vapor component | Wrap it in defineVaporComponent (or compile the SFC in vapor mode); blade rows need the vDOM outlet. |
| `core:invalid:code` | warn | no | A BusError code is not condition:subject from the vocabulary (dev only) | Use a condition from the vocabulary: missing, already, conflict, invalid, refused, unauthenticated, limited, timeout, lost, aborted, exceeded, failed, unexpected, unknown. |
| `reaction:invalid:pattern` | error | no | A reaction's pattern matches its own target | Narrow the pattern, or pass { allowSelfMatch: true } with a when guard that ends the chain. |
| `store:invalid:state` | warn | no | A server state for a store is not an object | Answer the store state as an object; this one is not written. |
| `store:invalid:version` | warn | no | A store answer's version() is not a number | Return a number from version(); answers without one are written in arrival order. |
| `store:invalid:clone` | warn | no | A shared store state is not structured-cloneable (dev only) | Keep the shared state plain data; this write stays in this tab. |
| `persist:invalid:state` | warn | no | A persisted state failed validate() | The stored value does not pass validate(): the store starts fresh. |
| `directive:invalid:modifier` | warn | no | v-vc-command.delegate was given .capture, .once or .passive (dev only) | Delegation shares one document listener with no per-element options: drop .delegate, or the other modifier. |
| `directive:invalid:app` | warn | no | The VDOM directive was installed on a Vapor app (dev only) | On a Vapor app use vcCommandVapor. |
| `bind:invalid:router` | warn | no | A data-vc-router names no router flag (dev only) | Write data-vc-router="loading" or "revalidating", and call routerFacts(router, bus) so the flags reach the bus. |
| `channel:invalid:clone` | warn | no | A channel payload is not structured-cloneable (dev only) | Send plain data, no functions or DOM nodes; this message stays in this tab. |
| `schema:invalid:key` | warn | no | A schema key normalizes to another action name (dev only) | Register and dispatch the action under the normalized name the schema validates and lists. |

<a id="refused"></a>

## refused

A rule or a party said no (403). Final.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: PERMISSION_DENIED.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transport:refused:redirect` | error | no | The backend answered with a redirect instead of a result | Pass an onRedirect handler to httpTransport (e.g. Inertia's router.visit), or stop the backend redirecting this command. |
| `router:refused:guard` | info | no | A beforeEach guard returned false | Intentional: the navigation is refused and the URL stays. Returned to the caller, not dispatched to onError. |
| `core:refused:bus` | error | no | Mutation attempted on a sealed bus | The bus was sealed with bus.seal(). Register all handlers/plugins before calling seal(). |

<a id="unauthenticated"></a>

## unauthenticated

No valid session or token (401, 419). Sign in, then send the same request.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: UNAUTHENTICATED.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authGuard:unauthenticated:action` | warn | no | The action is protected and the user is not authenticated | Sign in first, or remove the action from authGuard({ protected }). |

<a id="limited"></a>

## limited

A rate, a window or a circuit holds it back (429, 503). `context.retryIn` says when.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: yes when the handler or a transport returned it, never for a plugin's refusal or one at the sender (`pace`). gRPC: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / UNAVAILABLE.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `circuitBreaker:limited:action` | error | yes | Circuit breaker is open due to consecutive failures | Wait for resetTimeout to elapse. The circuit will transition to half-open and retry. |
| `rateLimit:limited:action` | error | yes | Rate limit exceeded for this action | Reduce call frequency or increase the max/window in rateLimit() options. |
| `transport:limited:socket` | warn | yes | The socket was not open: the command was not sent | The outbox keeps the record and sends it when the socket opens. Outside an outbox (a send racing a close), the async bus re-sends it after its backoff. |
| `transport:limited:held` | warn | yes | The server declared a limit for this action: the command was not sent | Wait context.retryIn ms, the time left of the server's Retry-After (or RateLimit, X-RateLimit-Reset). The async bus waits it and sends then, unless it is over maxDelay or retry is off. The outbox keeps the record. |
| `pace:limited:dispatch` | warn | yes | Throttled at the sender: this action and target ran within the wait | Wait for the throttle window to pass. Check context.retryIn for the remaining wait time. |

<a id="timeout"></a>

## timeout

No reply in time (408, 504).

Re-sent by the async bus by default: a 408 yes, a transport's own timeout or a 504 only when the command is idempotent or keyed. gRPC: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core:timeout:request` | error | yes | request() timed out waiting for a response | Increase the timeout option or check that respond() is registered for this action. |
| `outbox:timeout:queue` | warn | yes | The command waited longer than the outbox's ttl to be sent: dropped, never sent | Raise createOutbox({ ttl }), or wsTransport({ timeout }) for its own outbox. context.ttl is the limit. |
| `buffer:timeout:queue` | warn | yes | The command waited longer than the buffer's ttl for its handler: dropped, never run | The handler never registered in time (an island that failed to hydrate?). Raise createBuffer({ ttl }), or dispatch again once it has. context.ttl is the limit. |
| `transport:timeout:job` | error | no | An accepted job was not done within maxWait | The backend answered 202 and its status monitor kept answering 202: raise httpTransport({ poll: { maxWait } }) or check the job. Dispatching again starts the job again. |
| `transport:timeout:reply` | error | no | No reply arrived within the transport's own timeout | Raise the transport timeout option, or check the backend is answering. It may have landed, so the async bus re-sends it only for an idempotent action or a keyed command. Otherwise context.outcome is unknown: check its status on the server. |
| `directive:timeout:dispatch` | error | yes | A v-vc-command dispatch did not settle within its timeout | Raise the timeout modifier (v-vc-command.60000; default 30000 ms), or check that the handler or backend answers. context.timeout is the limit that passed. |
| `transition:timeout:settle` | warn | yes | A transition's dispatch did not settle within its timeout (dev only) | The element goes on so it is not stuck mid-transition. Raise timeout when the handler is legitimately slow. |

<a id="lost"></a>

## lost

The outcome is unknown, or data was dropped: the command may or may not have run.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: only when the command is idempotent or keyed. gRPC: none (gRPC UNAVAILABLE is retry-safe, which this is not).

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `transport:lost:result` | error | no | A batch answered without this command's result: it may have run | The backend must answer every batched command by the id it was sent. The outcome is unknown, so it is re-sent only with an idempotency key. |
| `transport:lost:reply` | error | no | The socket closed or was torn down before the reply arrived | Reconnect and dispatch again. The outcome is unknown, so the async bus re-sends it only for an idempotent action or a keyed command. |

<a id="aborted"></a>

## aborted

The caller cancelled.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: CANCELLED.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core:aborted:dispatch` | warn | no | Dispatch aborted via its AbortSignal before completion | Intentional cancellation (ac.abort()). Re-dispatch explicitly if the abort was premature. |
| `transport:aborted:request` | warn | no | The caller aborted the request (its AbortSignal) | Intentional cancellation. Send the request again if the abort was premature. |
| `outbox:aborted:clear` | warn | no | The queue lost the record before it was sent: outbox.clear() in this tab or another, or another tab dropped it by its maxSize | Intentional when the app cleared the queue. Dispatch again to send it; raise maxSize if another tab dropped it. |
| `buffer:aborted:clear` | warn | no | The bus was cleared while the command waited for its handler | Intentional: bus.clear() or dispose() ran. Dispatch again on a live bus. |
| `pace:aborted:dispatch` | info | no | A newer debounced call (or dispose) superseded this one before it ran | Normal flow: the latest call of a burst runs. Pass what changes per call as the payload, so a burst shares one key. |
| `router:aborted:navigation` | info | no | A newer navigation (or dispose) superseded this one | Normal flow: the latest navigation wins. Returned to the caller, not dispatched to onError. |

<a id="exceeded"></a>

## exceeded

A bound hit by a bug (recursion depth).

Re-sent by the async bus by default: no. gRPC: INTERNAL.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `outbox:exceeded:queue` | warn | no | The outbox held more than maxSize records and dropped the oldest: it was never sent | Raise createOutbox({ maxSize }), or flush more often. context.maxSize is the bound. |
| `buffer:exceeded:queue` | warn | no | More commands waited for their handler than the buffer holds: the oldest was dropped, never run | Register the handler sooner, or raise createBuffer({ maxSize }). context.maxSize is the bound. |
| `router:exceeded:redirects` | error | no | Guard redirects did not settle within the hop limit | Two guards redirect at each other. Break the cycle; a page reload cannot fix it, so this does not hard-navigate. |
| `core:exceeded:depth` | error | no | Recursive dispatch depth exceeded | A listener or reaction is re-dispatching in a loop. Break the cycle or add a guard condition. |
| `reaction:exceeded:hops` | error | no | A reaction chain exceeded maxHops | A reaction cycle: break it with a when guard, or raise maxHops. |

<a id="failed"></a>

## failed

Code threw or a step failed: a bug in the pipeline, or a backend's other 5xx.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: never for a bug of the pipeline; a backend's only when the command is idempotent or keyed. gRPC: INTERNAL.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `plugin:failed:plugin` | error | no | A plugin threw or rejected in one of its parts | A pipeline bug, not a server failure: error.cause is the original and context.part names the part (a rule or a work step). Return an errResult (err(fail(...))) instead of throwing. |
| `transport:failed:send` | error | no | A transport threw or rejected in its own send | A bug in the transport, not a server failure: error.cause is the original. Make send() answer a result instead of throwing. |
| `router:failed:guard` | error | no | A beforeEach guard threw | A bug in the guard: error.cause is its throw. Return false or a location instead of throwing; this does not hard-navigate. |
| `router:failed:history` | error | no | The router history threw writing the URL | A history the app supplied (createRouter({ history })) threw: error.cause is its throw. The navigation is reverted; this does not hard-navigate. |
| `router:failed:routes` | error | no | The routes endpoint failed | error.cause is the transport's failure; check the endpoint. start() rejects and onError receives it. |
| `router:failed:component` | error | no | A lazy component failed to load | Usually stale chunk hashes after a deploy: the default onError hard-navigates and the full load recovers. error.cause is the import's failure. |
| `router:failed:loader` | error | no | A route loader failed | error.cause is the loader's or the transport's failure. The page keeps its data; useRouteError surfaces it. |
| `router:failed:blade` | error | no | Fetching a blade route's server HTML failed | error.cause is the fetch's failure; the default onError hard-navigates so the server renders the page. |
| `router:failed:commit` | error | no | A post-commit hook or a snapshot subscriber threw | A bug in the hook or subscriber: the navigation stands. |
| `router:failed:hook` | error | no | An afterEach hook threw | A bug in the hook: the navigation stands. |
| `router:failed:revalidate` | error | no | A revalidateRoutes refresh failed | The error is the refresh's failure; the page keeps its data. Pass onError to handle it yourself. |
| `router:failed:navigation` | error | no | A navigation failed with an error that is not a router error | The error is its throw, reported by the default onError; pass onError to handle it. |
| `core:failed:listener` | error | no | A listener threw | A bug in the listener: the dispatch keeps its result and the other listeners run. Catch inside the listener when the throw is expected. |
| `core:failed:hook` | error | no | An onAfter hook threw | A bug in the hook: the dispatch keeps its result and the listeners run. Catch inside the hook when the throw is expected. |
| `core:failed:undo` | error | no | An optimistic action's undo failed after its work failed | The state may still hold the change: make the undo unable to fail, or reconcile from the server. |
| `core:failed:subscriber` | error | no | A command state subscriber threw | A bug in the subscriber: the dispatch goes on and the counts stay whole. |
| `core:failed:report` | error | no | A report formatter or sink threw | A bug in the formatter or sink given to configureReport: the report printed through the defaults. |
| `history:failed:move` | error | no | An undo handler or a redo dispatch threw | The step is reverted: the error is its throw. |
| `test:failed:hook` | error | no | An onAfter hook threw on the test bus | A bug in the hook: the dispatch keeps its result. |
| `test:failed:listener` | error | no | A listener threw on the test bus | A bug in the listener: the dispatch keeps its result. |
| `store:failed:push` | error | no | A server push failed to write a store | The error is the store's throw; that store keeps its state. |
| `store:failed:subscriber` | error | no | A $onField subscriber threw | A bug in the subscriber: the write stands and the later subscribers run. |
| `store:failed:cleanup` | error | no | A store cleanup threw during $dispose | A bug in the cleanup: the other cleanups still run. |
| `persist:failed:save` | warn | no | Saving a persisted store failed | The storage threw (full, or blocked): the error is its throw. The store keeps its state. |
| `persist:failed:load` | warn | no | Loading a persisted store failed | The stored value could not be read or parsed: the store starts fresh. |
| `persist:failed:replay` | warn | no | Replaying the writes made before the load threw | A write made before the stored value was read threw on replay: the store keeps its state. |
| `http:failed:listener` | error | no | An onInvalidateGroup listener threw | A bug in the listener: the other listeners run and the groups are dropped. |
| `transport:failed:onEvent` | error | no | The SSE bridge's onEvent threw | A bug in onEvent: the bridge stays open and reads the next event. |
| `transport:failed:onBroadcast` | error | no | The Echo bridge's broadcast handler threw | A bug in onBroadcast: the bridge keeps listening. |
| `widget:failed:load` | error | no | A widget's component failed to load | The error is the import's failure: check the chunk path, or stale hashes after a deploy. |
| `reaction:failed:dispatch` | error | no | A reaction's dispatch threw | The error is the throw of the target's dispatch. |

<a id="unexpected"></a>

## unexpected

The other side answered off the protocol (501, 502, 505).

Re-sent by the async bus by default: only when the command is idempotent or keyed. gRPC: INTERNAL / UNKNOWN.

| code | severity | retryable | what | fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `remote:unexpected:json` | error | no | The response is not valid JSON, or not the command envelope | The backend answered off-protocol: fix the body, its Content-Type, or the envelope shape. Re-sent only for an idempotent request. |
| `router:unexpected:routes` | error | no | The routes payload is not JSON or has no routes array | The server sent the table off-protocol: answer { routes: [...] } from the endpoint or the inline element. error.cause holds a parse error. |
| `core:unexpected:promise` | warn | no | A sync bus dispatch returned a Promise (dev only) | An async step or rule is installed: use createAsyncCommandBus(). |
| `core:unexpected:signal` | warn | no | Signals were created before Vue was detected (dev only) | await waitForVueDetection() before creating signals at module init; harmless when they are never read reactively. |
| `store:unexpected:reducer` | warn | no | A reducer gave two different states for one input | Mint ids and times in the call, not in the reducer: a rollback replays the reducer and must get the same state. |
| `vue:unexpected:probe` | warn | no | Vue was detected at runtime, not at build time (dev only) | Import the composables from vapor-chamber/vue (or vapor-chamber/vapor in a Vapor app); a production bundle cannot resolve the runtime import. |

<a id="unknown"></a>

## unknown

The fallback.

Re-sent by the async bus by default: only when the command is idempotent or keyed. gRPC: UNKNOWN.
